name: Refine Frame
description: Image placeholder frame that visualizes AI image generation: a pixelated mosaic of the child image sharpens in steps as status moves from queued to complete, with a status chip and retry button.
contents: Aspect-ratio frame that holds a child image (children)
Canvas mosaic that progressively refines from coarse blocks to the full image with a top-down wipe edge and glint
Status chip with icon and label, plus a centered retry button on error
behavior: Status drives blur, saturation, scale and opacity per stage, queued pulses gently
Once the child img loads, a canvas replaces it and steps through 9 pixelation levels toward the target for the status
Complete shows the sharp image, error dims and blurs it and shows the retry button when onRetry is set
Chip fades out after hideAfter ms once complete
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by jumping to the target and disabling sweeps and spinners
editableByProps: Current status, size (width capped to container), aspect ratio, corner radius
Refine speed per stage, sweep on or off, chip visibility and auto-hide delay
Status labels and retry label, retry handler, the image itself via children

needsCodeEdit.change: Change per-stage look or progress targets
Change the error chip color or icons
needsCodeEdit.where: Status chip block, data-kind=error class and HugeiconsIcon usages

fixed: Needs a child img element, the mosaic is built from the first img found inside children; without it only the blur and status chip show
Image should be CORS-readable (same origin or crossOrigin set) so the canvas can draw it
Injects a style tag with refine-frame keyframes inside the component
Width is a fixed pixel value capped at 100% of the parent, the frame is not centered by itself
Component is a client component and uses canvas and requestAnimationFrame
Status chip is fixed at the bottom left and the retry button is centered, with 12px text
